context_note: Ilyès Djadel (Marrakech du Rire 2022): school trip to Lourdes, sits in an empty wheelchair to rest, spends the day with a group of disabled pilgrims, then stands up out of respect when the Pope arrives and is taken for a miracle — standing ovation. Ovation kept uncut (raw range).
